::: {.key-facts}
At the 2022 census, 70,259 people lived in County Roscommon, up 8.9% on 2016. It had the 21st largest population of the 26 counties.

Its population in 2022 was 28% of its population in 1841, the last census before the Great Famine.

In 2025, the average monthly rent on a new tenancy in County Roscommon was €1,092, the 22nd highest of the 26 counties.
:::
